items.title: Tata Motors confident of delivering industry-leading growth in FY27 despite global uncertainties: Chandrasekaran
items.summary: Chairman N Chandrasekaran said the company will continue to deepen collaboration with Jaguar Land Rover while investing in electrification, technology and manufacturing capabilities.

items.title: Volkswagen reduces production at German plant amid uncertain future for site
items.summary: Volkswagen is reducing production of the T-Roc Cabrio SUV at its Osnabrueck plant. This move is linked to seasonal demand for convertibles. Employee representatives are worried about the plant's future and the jobs of its 2,300 workers.

items.title: BMW cuts 2026 outlook on China downturn, Iran war
items.summary: BMW has significantly lowered its 2026 profit outlook, citing an accelerated downturn in the Chinese market and the impact of the Iran war. The company now anticipates a much lower EBIT margin for its automotive segment and expects a decrease in core deliveries.

items.title: Mercedes-Benz India confident of sustaining growth on strong demand this year
items.summary: Mercedes-Benz India is confident in achieving growth this year, driven by strong demand despite economic and geopolitical challenges. The premium automaker plans a price increase due to the depreciating Indian Rupee and other cost pressures.

items.title: Tata Motors PV to hike vehicle prices across portfolio by up to 1.5% from July 1
items.summary: The automaker said the price revision is aimed at partially offsetting the impact of rising input costs and persistent inflationary pressures.

items.title: Motovolt Deploys Over 200 MVS7 Electric Vehicles Through GBG EV Partnership in Delhi NCR
items.summary: Motovolt Mobility has expanded its partnership with electric vehicle fleet rental operator GBG EV, deploying more than 200 units of its MVS7 electric two-wheelers for last-mile delivery operations across Delhi NCR. The vehicles are equipped with battery-swapping technology supplied by Indofast.

items.title: CV Retail Sales May 2026 – Tata, Mahindra, Ashok Leyland, VECV, Maruti Suzuki, Daimlar
items.summary: Commercial vehicle retail sales in India registered moderate growth in May 2026, supported primarily by Tata Motors and Mahindra The post CV Retail Sales May 2026 – Tata, Mahindra, Ashok Leyland, VECV, Maruti Suzuki, Daimlar appeared first on RushLane .

items.title: Omega Seiki Mobility Integrates Honda e:Swap Battery Ecosystem With Rage+ Electric Cargo Three-Wheeler
items.summary: Omega Seiki Mobility (OSM) has announced the integration of Honda’s e battery-swapping ecosystem with its Rage+ electric cargo three-wheeler, expanding battery-swapping options for commercial electric vehicle operators in India. Under the arrangement, the OSM Rage+ will be compatible with Honda’s battery-swapping infrastructure, allowing users to exchange depleted batteries for fully charged units within minutes i...

items.title: Maruti Suzuki launches prepaid Smart Maintenance Plan for existing vehicle owners
items.summary: The plan lets customers prepay maintenance expenses, offering protection against future service cost inflation while providing flexible tenure and mileage options across passenger and commercial vehicles.

items.title: UltraTech deploys 45 e-trucks for clinker transportation in northern India
items.summary: The initiative is expected to reduce more than 8,900 tonnes of CO2 emissions annually and displace around 2.9 million litres of diesel consumption each year.

items.title: New Audi A6 Allroad Debuts – Diesel, PHEV 95 Km EV Range
items.summary: New Audi A6 Allroad has just debuted bringing the widebody treatment from RS6 to mainstream buyers along with Diesel and PHEV engine options The post New Audi A6 Allroad Debuts – Diesel, PHEV 95 Km EV Range appeared first on RushLane .

items.title: JLR ramps up cybersecurity, China focus after FY26 setback
items.summary: The luxury carmaker aims to reduce its breakeven volume to 300,000 units over two years as it strengthens cybersecurity, sharpens its China strategy and prepares for key EV launches.

items.title: Germany's battery production hits record high in 2025 on EV
items.summary: Germany's battery production hit a record €8.1 billion in 2025, fueled by electric vehicles and energy storage. Lithium-ion battery output surged 28 per cent. While domestic production is growing, China remains the dominant supplier, raising concerns about European competitiveness and dependence on Asian supply chains.

items.title: Tsuyo Manufacturing to represent India at VivaTech 2026 in Paris
items.summary: The company plans to showcase its electric powertrain and patented motor technologies at the event as it looks to engage with global industry stakeholders and explore international opportunities.

items.title: From 'Made in India' to 'Made for India': Renault's engineering vision for India
items.summary: In this interview, Dr. Vikraman V, Chief of Renault Engineering, Renault Group India, explains why ‘Made in India’ must evolve into ‘Made for India’ through India-specific engineering. He also outlines Renault's roadmap for hybrids and EVs, discusses the country's evolving powertrain mix, and shares why OEMs can no longer afford to be mono-fuel companies.

items.title: Mercedes launches mass production of electric motor for high-performance AMG brand
items.summary: Mercedes-Benz has begun series production of a new lightweight axial flux electric motor at its Berlin-Marienfelde plant. This innovative technology, designed to be lighter and more efficient than traditional motors, aims to address the challenges of electrifying high-performance AMG vehicles.

items.title: Mercedes-Benz launches S-Class plug-in hybrid in India at ₹2.20 crore
items.summary: The S 450e combines a 3.0-litre inline six-cylinder turbo-petrol engine with an electric motor and a 22-kWh battery pack, producing a combined output of 435 hp and 680 Nm of torque.

items.title: EV demand surges in India as fuel prices rise; Maruti, Mercedes-Benz face delivery delays
items.summary: Companies like Maruti, Mercedes-Benz, and BMW are experiencing unprecedented interest in their electric vehicles. Supply chain issues are now limiting production more than customer interest.

items.title: China's BYD ramps up battery production in Brazil
items.summary: Chinese electric carmaker BYD is boosting battery production in Brazil. The company plans significant investment in energy storage systems to support Brazil's national grid. This expansion is part of a strategy to become Brazil's top car brand by 2030.

items.title: Top Indian Tyre Makers Line Up Over ₹7,500 Crore Capex For FY27
items.summary: India’s leading tyre makers are preparing a fresh round of capital expenditure for FY27 and the years ahead, as capacity utilisation across key product categories moves close to peak levels and demand remains steady across replacement and original equipment channels. Apollo Tyres, CEAT, JK Tyre & Industries and Balkrishna Industries have together outlined large capex plans covering truck and bus radial tyres, pass...

items.title: Marelli marks 300 F1 events with SDR, unveils upgraded system
items.summary: The system, developed with the Fédération Internationale de l'Automobile, is installed on all Formula 1 cars and provides real-time data to support safety monitoring and regulatory compliance during races.
